extDescription.message: Tells the AniSync app on your PC which anime episode you're watching, to keep your AniList or MyAnimeList list up to date.

appNotRunning.message: AniSync isn't running on this PC

notActiveHere.message: AniSync isn't active on this site

enableHint.message: AniSync only reads the streaming sites you allow. Your browser will ask for your permission.

enablePlayerHint.message: This page's video player comes from another site. Allow it so AniSync can read the episode.

enableRefused.message: Permission not granted: AniSync won't read this site.
